import io, re
from dotenv import parser

# 1) defective behaviour simulation: line never advances
orig = parser.Position.advance
def bad(self, s):
    self.chars += len(s)
    self.line += 0
parser.Position.advance = bad
rows = list(parser.parse_stream(io.StringIO("X=1\r\nY=2\nZ=3\n")))
print("defective:", [r.original.line for r in rows])
parser.Position.advance = orig
rows = list(parser.parse_stream(io.StringIO("X=1\r\nY=2\nZ=3\n")))
print("current  :", [r.original.line for r in rows])
print("raw lines:", [(r.original.line, repr(r.original.string)) for r in rows])

# 2) CRLF counted once, not twice
for s in ["\r\n", "\n", "\r", "a\r\nb\nc\rd"]:
    print(repr(s), "->", len(parser._newline.findall(s)))
EOF

cd /workspace && python - <<'EOF'
import io
from dotenv.parser import parse_stream

cases = [
    "A=1\nB=2\nC=3\n",
    "A=1\r\nB=2\r\nC=3\r\n",
    "A=1\rB=2\rC=3\r",
    "\n\nA=1\n\nB=2\n",
    "  \t\nA=1\r\n\r\nB=2\n",
    "A=1\r\nB=2\nC=3\r\n",
    "A=1",                      # no trailing newline
]
for text in cases:
    rows = list(parse_stream(io.StringIO(text)))
    got = [(r.original.line, r.original.string) for r in rows]
    # expected first line of each original slice
    exp = []
    ln = 1
    for r in rows:
        exp.append(ln)
        ln += len(__import__('re').findall(r"\r\n|\n|\r", r.original.string))
    print(repr(text))
    print("   lines:", [g[0] for g in got], "expected:", exp, "slices ok:",
          all(text.find(g[1]) >= 0 for g in got))
EOF
